text.value: Laboratory Report

tr.th: Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:

tr.td: The urine results indicate a urinary tract infection (UTI) with significant bacteriuria (E. coli >100,000 CFU/mL), pyuria (elevated leukocytes), nitrites, and positive leukocyte esterase. Hematuria and presence of blood are also noted. Glucosuria is present without ketones, which may warrant further evaluation for possible glycosuria/diabetes. Low specific gravity suggests dilute urine. Recommend clinical correlation and appropriate antibiotic therapy; consider further assessment for underlying causes of glucosuria.
